name: PII blocking — Luhn-valid SIN is redacted before the LLM call
description: Sends a Luhn-valid SIN in the prompt and asserts the orchestrator emits a pii_warning event. The LLM call must still occur (PII is redacted, not aborted) — but the warning is the durable evidence the chokepoint fired.

request.prompt: My SIN is 046 454 286. Please confirm receipt and summarize the data classification policy.
